\# Project-wide Copilot instructions



\## Stack

\- Backend: Laravel / PHP

\- Frontend: Vue 3 + Vuetify 3

\- Additional modules: PDF generation, revision/evidence pipeline, Chrome extension

\- Prefer backward-compatible changes unless task explicitly allows breaking changes



\## Working style

\- For any non-trivial task, first inspect the existing code and write a short plan

\- List affected files before editing

\- Prefer minimal targeted changes over broad rewrites

\- Preserve existing routes, controllers, and legacy flows unless explicitly asked to replace them

\- For cross-cutting tasks, implement in phases



\## Coding rules

\- Do not refactor unrelated code

\- Do not rename public API endpoints without explicit instruction

\- Do not rewrite large files wholesale if a surgical patch is possible

\- Keep legacy and new flow side by side during transition using adapters or feature flags



\## Validation

\- After edits, run only relevant checks for changed files

\- Report what checks were run and what was not run

\- If migrations are changed, include migration safety notes



\## Output format

Always provide:

1\. short plan

2\. files changed

3\. risks

4\. checks run

5\. next recommended step

## Large task policy

For large cross-cutting tasks, do not implement the full scope in one pass.

Always:

\- analyze first

\- split into bounded blocks

\- implement only one block at a time

\- preserve backward compatibility

\- prefer new modules/services over invasive rewrites



\## Repository-specific priorities

\- The codebase contains legacy flows that must remain operational during transition

\- Revision/evidence/PDF features should be evolved incrementally

\- Large Vue view files should not be rewritten wholesale

\- New backend domain concepts should be introduced with explicit lifecycle/state modeling
